title: Hello T4
hypothesis: A token-only Kaggle kernel can start a public GPU run and hand back a real hardware card: the accelerator Kaggle actually assigns, its VRAM and driver, a CUDA version, and an fp16 matmul throughput we can quote as a measured number.
success_metric: results/timings.json containing a non-null gpu name, vram_mb and metric, harvested with no browser.

gpu.gate: lab.quota.decide_gpu_job -- 1h of an 8h session cap, week reads 0.00h/30.00h

eval.dataset: 5 riddles, deterministic regex grading (no LLM judge)
eval.why: W0 calibration: the first real $/call and tokens/call priors. Every later estimated_usd in a run manifest depends on this number.
eval.limit: two models per kaggle b t run (AGENTS.md), so 3 models is 2 invocations
